message.content:
An editorial illustration features a red masthead at the top containing the large, partially obscured letters "TEMPO". Smaller white text above reads "INTRIK DAN KLIK PENETAPAN KAPOLRI" and "BOM WAKTU JIWASRAYA". Below the masthead, "KABINET ANTI-RADIKALISME" is written in large black letters, followed by smaller Indonesian text and publication details at the bottom left, including the date "28 OKTOBER- 3 NOVEMBER 2019".

The central composition shows several figures in light-colored shirts and dark trousers. In the foreground, four men stand on a white ground. One man on the left and another on the right stand with hands on hips. The two middle men reach upward with long-handled paint rollers. The rollers have white heads and are being used to apply white paint over a larger, red-toned background illustration. This background depicts six human figures with their faces obscured or partially covered by white paint. One figure wears a dark balaclava, while others wear glasses or hats. The figures in the background are rendered in flat, orange and tan tones. A person on the right holds a large red rectangular board upwards. All figures are stylized with simplified features. A barcode and price are visible in the bottom-left corner.
